# Richard Bråse: “Vill äga bortsprungna aktier”

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-11-12  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Börslunch (EFN) interviews Proteam fund manager Richard Bråse, a contrarian value investor who wants to own 'stray stocks' that the market has abandoned, steering clear of over-leveraged 'debt bombs'. He thinks prices move far more than company values and likes turbulence. He bought Heba near multi-year lows and recently added real estate stocks, Nordea and SEB. He also highlights Kongsberg Maritime and FLSmidth as cheap after they narrowed their businesses. The news segment covers Nvidia's CEO scandal, Telia's acquisition and Surgical Science's lukewarm report.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HEBA-B — Heba | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Guest bought an SBB block at multi-year lows. Best residential portfolio, 75% surplus ratio, ~0% vacancy, digital leader.

#### Reasoning

Bråse (guest, fund manager) expects the real estate sector to split into winners and losers by surplus ratio and vacancy. Heba is overlooked and seen as a stuffy family company, yet leads on quality metrics. Contrarian, long-term: 'buy the capital city and buy Heba'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if vacancy rises materially
- if surplus ratio deteriorates
- if valuation re-rates to fair value

> *"Då köper man huvudstaden och så köper man Heba."*

---

### 🟢 NDA-SE — Nordea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Second-largest holding, bought after the regulatory dip; most interesting bank on valuation.

#### Reasoning

Guest added Nordea and SEB after a regulatory scare pushed banks down. He thinks the uncertainty about the absolute outcome can be narrowed from management guidance. He is not bullish on bank multiples in general because banks are leveraged, regulated hybrids.

#### Sell Triggers

- if regulator (ECB/FI) imposes larger capital requirements than guided
- if bank valuations re-rate strongly

> *"Det är den fortsatt mest intressanta banken. Annars hade det inte varit det näst största innehavet."*

---

### 🟢 SEB-A — SEB | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest bought a lot of SEB after the regulatory-driven decline.

#### Reasoning

Opportunistic buy after the regulatory dip, on the same logic as Nordea. Less conviction was stated than for Nordea.

#### Sell Triggers

- if regulatory risk-weight changes worsen
- if valuation re-rates

> *"Det kan vara så att jag köpte ganska mycket Nordea och SEB, när de hade gått ner på det där tillräckligt mycket."*

---

### 🟠 FLS — FLSmidth | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Pure-play mining equipment, cheap vs Metso, buyout option (Sandvik); new targets disappointing.

#### Reasoning

After narrowing its business, FLSmidth is the purest mining equipment play and looks very cheap against Metso. The strong report showed strong demand for the next two years. Sandvik is a natural acquirer. The new financial targets disappointed on margin and organic growth. Suggested pair trade: long FLS, short Metso.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin targets keep disappointing
- if mining equipment demand weakens

> *"Du kan ställa den mot Metso och då ser den ju fasligt billig ut egentligen."*

---

### ⛔ METSO — Metso | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Short leg of the suggested pair trade versus FLSmidth.

#### Reasoning

Metso was only discussed as relatively expensive compared with FLSmidth. The pair trade was half in jest.

#### Sell Triggers

- if FLSmidth valuation gap closes

> *"lägga på en kort mezzo och lång FLS"*

---

### 🟢 MYCR — Mycronic | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Guest bought AI-trade-correlated stocks like Mycronic after last week's selloff.

#### Reasoning

Opportunistic buying of stocks hit by the AI-trade selloff, based on unclear correlation. No fundamental thesis was given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI-correlated rebound completes

> *"I slutet på förra veckan köpte jag mycket av de här grejerna som är ibland oklara grunder korrelerade med AI-traden, eller vad man ska säga. Mycronic"*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

CEO scandal and board probe; analysts cited by CNBC see ~20% downside if CEO fired. Guest has no view.

#### Reasoning

News segment: ~10% drop and ~$700bn of market value lost. Analysts quoted by CNBC (cited, not host) see a further ~20% fall if Huang is ousted. Bråse says the multiple looks low but the long-term normalized margin is unknown.

#### Sell Triggers

- if board removes CEO

> *"flera av analytikerna som de pratat med tror att aktien kan falla runt 20 procent om styrelsen beslutar sig för att sparka vdn"*

---

### 🟢 BRBY — Burberry | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Sales beat expectations against a weak luxury sector; Goldman Sachs buy rating (cited analyst).

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion only: Goldman Sachs put a buy rating on Burberry after strong performance and demand for its classic products.

#### Sell Triggers

- if luxury slowdown spreads to Burberry

> *"i förra veckan satt Goldman Sachs sin köpare. stämpel"*
